transfers.date_basis: 三重県令告示 dated 明治13年5月10日 says the 15 villages were handed to Aichi "本月七日" = 1880-05-07 (solar calendar already; no conversion). Wikipedia 桑名郡/海西郡 give 5月10日, which is the date of the notice, not of the handover.
transfers.matters_for_intervals: All intervals before 1880-05-07 in which 桑名郡 (安濃津県 1872-01-02..1872-04-24; 三重県 1872-04-24..1876-04-18; 三重県 1876-04-18..1880-05-07) and 海西郡 (名古屋県/愛知県) differ: the 15 villages sit on the MIE side until 1880-05-07 and on the AICHI side afterwards. The 三重県 interval 1876-04-18..1881-02-07 must be cut at 1880-05-07. Before 1872-01-02 (outside the withheld list): 五明村/小島新田/福原新田/川原欠新田 were 旧幕府領 -> 長島藩領 (1871-01) i.e. 長島県, the others 桑名県/度会県 area; all Ise side anyway.

transfers.notes: CORRECTION of the source: 神崎郡 (滋賀県) says 神崎郡 passed 長浜県 -> 大津県 on 1872-01-09 (citing 太政官日誌 第105号). That is the 高島郡 sentence of the 高島郡/犬上県/大津県 articles with the direction reversed: those state 高島郡 moved 大津県 -> 長浜県 on 1872-01-09 (same citation), 大津県 lists only 南部5郡, 滋賀県 says 長浜県 = 高島郡・神崎郡以北, 犬上県 lists 神崎郡, 愛知郡 says whole 長浜県. So 神崎郡 stays 長浜県 -> 犬上県 -> 滋賀県 (1872-10-30), as the assembly already has. Sweep rows "1879 愛知川村 神崎->愛知" and "1897 葉枝見村" are within 滋賀県 (irrelevant); "称して南須田村, 85村" are parse artefacts. Whether 須田村 (寺社領) was 大津県 in 1872: 蒲生郡 article says 寺社領 -> 大津県 (1871-10) and 全域 大津県 on 1872-01-02.

transfers.date_basis: Both 安濃郡 and 一志郡 articles place the change under 明治5年. The sweep dated it 1879 by mistake (year-context); the 安濃郡 article bullet is a sub-bullet of 明治5年 following the 3月17日 (1872-04-24) renaming, but sub-bullet order does not fix the date.

transfers.matters_for_intervals: 1872-01-02..1876-04-18: 一志郡 = 度会県 but 安濃郡 = 安濃津県 (to 1872-04-24) then 三重県 (to 1876-04-18). Conclusion (see notes): treat 垂水・藤方・伊予町・八幡町 as 安濃津県/三重県 for ALL of 1872-01-02..1876-04-18 (and after), never 度会県. So the 度会県 interval takes NO part of 藤水村 or 津市; the 1920 一志郡 町村 lose nothing.

transfers.notes: The sweep rows "1879 安濃郡" and "1872 一志郡" are ONE event (明治5年, both articles). REASONING: (1) 津藩 = 津県 was merged into 安濃津県, 久居県 into 度会県 (三重県 article); 度会県 took over the 津県/久居県 parts of its counties only in 1872-03/04 (度会県 article). (2) 旧高旧領取調帳 (compiled before this) already lists 垂水・藤方 under 安濃郡, i.e. de facto Tsu-city territory. (3) The 相川 boundary was fixed in the same year, evidently when the counties were handed to 度会県 - so these four never effectively passed to 度会県. Residual doubt: for a few weeks of 1872 (01-02 .. date of 相川 decision) they were nominally 一志郡 = 度会県 on paper; we treat the de facto 安濃津県. Also (outside scope) the other 津藩領 villages of 一志郡 were likewise de facto 安濃津県 until the spring 1872 handover although nominally 度会県.

corrections: The 1879 安濃郡 and 1872 一志郡 rows are one event dated 明治5年 (1872), not 1879.
The 1880 transfer is 三重県桑名郡 -> 愛知県海西郡 (IN for the Aichi article), handover 1880-05-07 (notice 05-10), 15 villages; the sweep "out" and its village list ("存在した福原新田", "95村") are parse noise.

Rows "1887/1889 海西郡 (岐阜県)", "1889 安八郡", "1887 中島郡 (岐阜県)" are partly mirrors of the Aichi-side events and partly Gifu-internal; the 安八郡/海西郡 (岐阜) 1889 changes (勝賀村・蛇池村, 古中島村) never cross a prefecture - they were withheld only because Aichi 海西郡 has the same name.
神崎郡 (滋賀県) article: the "1872-01-09 長浜県 -> 大津県" line is wrong (copied from 高島郡 with the direction reversed); 神崎郡 stays 長浜県 -> 犬上県 -> 滋賀県.
Wikipedia 桑名郡/海西郡 date 1880-05-10 is the notice date; actual hand-over 1880-05-07.
Missed by the sweep: 1883 三重県桑名郡 江内村・油島新田・金廻村 -> 岐阜県下石津郡 (see transfer 10).
一志郡 article says the whole 一志郡 became 度会県 on 1872-01-02, yet its 津藩領 villages were 津県 (-> 安濃津県); 度会県 only received them in 1872-03/04. This affects other 一志郡 町村 outside this cluster.
